summary: Star Bulk Carriers Corp. filed a Form 6-K on May 26, 2026, containing its unaudited interim financial statements and a press release for the three months ended March 31, 2026. This is a routine earnings report for a foreign private issuer, with no special-situations event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring. The filing also incorporates these documents by reference into existing registration statements. There are no deal terms, activist campaigns, or other special situation elements. This is a standard periodic financial disclosure, not a special situation.
